text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With our next objective, the<n>Japanese Derby,
drawing closer, the<n>focus of Symboli Rudolf's
training<n>sessions has shifted to ironing out<n>the
creases.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Another productive session. Thank<n>you for agreeing
to be my partner.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
N-not at all... Glad to help... Anyway,<n>um... I should
go...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: That was... crazy... She's so... fast...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I apologize for<n>putting you
through so much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I mean in finding me a training<n>partner. I expect it
wasn't so easy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She can say that again. When I asked<n>people if they
wanted to be running<n>partners with the Emperor,
most of<n>them backed out and said they<n>weren't
qualified.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I had to pull some strings with a<n>fellow trainer to
finally secure<n>someone who was willing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I also owe my partner an apology. I<n>could see that
she was quite shaken.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I try my best not to intimidate those<n>around me, but I
can only hold back<n>so much while on the track.
choice_data_list: Especially with the real thing on the horizon.
Especially with the real thing on the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I suspect I'm so on edge that<n>I don't even
realize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No race symbolizes the dream of all<n>racers quite
like the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is a prize I must take if I'm to have<n>any pride as
Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is little time left until the race.<n>We must buckle
down and keep<n>practicing as best we can.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems fulfilled in mind<n>and body as
she makes progress<n>toward the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for bringing you all the<n>way to the
student council office.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to look<n>over before we
start training. Could<n>you wait here? I won't be long.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you can't delegate it to anyone?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately not, I'm afraid.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The last time I stepped back from my<n>student
council work, I missed the<n>signs that one of my
subordinates<n>was in distress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't let that happen again. The only<n>choice is to
balance both duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if this is beyond me, I have<n>no chance of
realizing my dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? What's this?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf comes to a stop in front of the<n>student
council office. A sheet of<n>paper is affixed to the
door.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's work, I suspect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do appreciate that she's worried for<n>my
well-being...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But still, it's unusual for her to resort<n>to such
drastic measures—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Just then, the door is flung open from<n>within.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh, forget this nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian. Going somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Funny time for you to drop by, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm caught in the crossfire between<n>you and Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Would you mind explaining to me<n>what is going on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... So Air Groove has been<n>asking you to
handle the work that<n>would otherwise have come to
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Empress wouldn't take no for an<n>answer on
this one. Screwed my<n>schedule right up, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can only apologize. I take full<n>responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If not for my failings, Air Groove<n>wouldn't have felt
the need to<n>increase your burden in order to<n>reduce
my own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Once again, this is my fault, not yours.<n>I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not asking for an apology...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. I'm going on patrol.<n>The rest is
your problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, this needs to be revised. We'll<n>have to ask
them to recalculate it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, what's next...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President? Aren't you supposed to<n>be training?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What are you working on?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was reviewing the council's budget<n>proposal for
the upcoming academic<n>period.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That must be a lot of work. Let me<n>lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not! I am doing thisspecifically to reduce your burden.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is no time for you to be filing<n>paperwork. I'll
take care of this while<n>you focus on—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Remind me, Air Groove. Which one of<n>us is the
president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Delegating the student council's<n>workload is my
job. You can trust me<n>to do it, no matter what else I
might be<n>dealing with.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With all due respect—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you truly have so little faith in me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly believe I would let my<n>student council
activities lead to<n>defeat on the track?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then what's the harm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...For what it's worth, I do appreciate<n>the sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, Trainer, but I must attend<n>to this. I'll be
right with you.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, since you're offering, I<n>suppose there is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to burden you with<n>busywork, but could
you help<n>organize these files?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
More work keeps on popping up, to<n>the point where
our training session<n>ends up delayed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, Symboli Rudolf insists on<n>training for
the allotted time.
